problems: sultanate-of-kutai-kartanegara has no dossier of its own: kutai-kingdom.json (earlier batch) covers both Names, as the brief instructs; the Kutai page (opened) confirms one continuous state.

surakarta-sunanate starts 20 February 1745 on its own page, but the mataram-sultanate dossier (se-02) keeps Mataram as one realm to 1755 and lists Surakarta as successor: 1745-1754 overlaps its 1743-1754 keyframe; the reviewer should decide whether Surakarta starts in 1755.

sultan-of-yogyakarta and surakarta-sunanate end in 1830 (following Cliopatria's 1829) although both courts continued as protectorate states to 1945/1946; the pages show about 115 years of undrawn rump states.

Suzerain-side vassal events are needed in other dossiers: dutch-east-indies for kingdom-of-bulungan (Dutch protectorate 27 September 1834, incorporation June 1878, recorded here as a rename status caption); dutch-republic/batavian-republic/dutch-east-indies/british-colonial-empire for the VOC, Batavian, Netherlands and British East India Company protectorates of Yogyakarta and Surakarta (infobox years on the two pages); rattanakosin-kingdom dates Terengganu's vassalage from 1786 where the Terengganu page says 1871; its counterpart is written 'Terengganu', not the slug.
Cliopatria rows end before the real states: Bulungan 1747 (page: 1878), Terengganu 1904 (page: 9 July 1909); new keyframes were added from the same outlines.

The three Selangor outlines and the Terengganu/Bulungan/Yogyakarta/Surakarta outlines were compared by grid cells with the gazetteer; none of the pages opened gives an area for Terengganu, Bulungan, Selangor or Surakarta, so only Yogyakarta's infobox figure (3,133 km2) was available as a sanity check.
Quotes in notes are WebFetch answers to verbatim-quote prompts, not independent copies of the pages.
Two of the six owned states needed three pages instead of the 1-2 page budget (Yogyakarta, Surakarta: article plus Giyanti and Java War, shared); the Berau page for Bulungan failed twice.
